note: Free substitutes for paid dataset classes. auth=none is key-less; free_key rows are used only when the named environment variable is present on the box (the engine reads the NAME only, never the value); ua rows need a declared User-Agent. Paid tiers and login-walled pages are never fetched: rows whose full data is paid say so in `licence` and use only the free headline.
